anomalies.expected: Per the specification and the firmware, SCK must be on GPIO5 (U1 pin 17) and the chip-selects CS0/CS1/CS2 on GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 (U1 pins 18/21/22). The four SPI/CS nets are shifted by one MCU pin relative to the intended design.

evidence.quote: SCK (pin 5) and SO (pin 7, tri-state/MISO) are common nets (SCK, SO) tied to all three ICs and to the ESP32 (U1 GPIO5/SCK, GPIO10/SO). Each chip has its own independent chip-select: ~{CS} (pin 6) on U2/U3/U4 goes to separate nets CS0/CS1/CS2, driven by ESP32 GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 respectively.
SPI2 on GPIO5/GPIO10, CS pins GPIO4/6/7

anomalies.impact: The shared SPI bus to all three MAX31855 thermocouple interfaces is mis-assigned: the firmware drives SCK on GPIO5 (which the board routes to CS1) and CS0 on GPIO4 (which the board routes to SCK), while U2's CS0 net sits on GPIO3 that the firmware never toggles. Clock and chip-selects are therefore wrong for every channel, so all thermocouple reads fail; the firmware's ThermocoupleFault path trips and the heater is never enabled, rendering the oven controller inoperable.
